questions.question: ทำไม pipeline ต้อง execute stages แบบ sequential 而不是 parallel?
choices: Sequential is faster than parallel execution
Test stage needs code to be complete first — dependency chain
AI tools can only run one at a time
questions.explanation: In the SDLC, test stage depends on code stage output. Testing code that doesn't exist yet is meaningless. Sequential execution respects the dependency chain.

questions.question: Pipeline report แสดง '5 stages, 3 AI-enhanced' — 3 หมายถึงอะไร?
choices: 3 stages ที่ใช้ AI tools (aiEnhanced: true)
3 stages ที่ล้มเหลว
3 stages ที่เป็น manual
3 stages ที่รันซ้ำ
questions.explanation: The report counts stages where aiEnhanced is true. This provides transparency about which parts of the pipeline are AI-assisted vs manual.

questions.question: ถ้าส่ง empty array เข้า createPipeline() แล้ว execute() ควร return อะไร?
questions.explanation: An empty pipeline has no stages to execute, so it should return an empty results array — not throw an error. Good code handles empty input gracefully.
